items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: When I was with Desveen I couldn't play like I was playing now.

ctx.x: You got a nice beat. You got a nice beat.

Nice beat. What is your worst... I never did... I'm not too familiar with chords, you understand? Card forms. I'm not too familiar with that, but I got a good ear. When I was with Desveen I couldn't play like I was playing now. I could play melody, but I couldn't play that jazz, you understand? Get off. It just comes to me. I just hear the banjo, the piano, if he hitting that chord I can hear it. I know this way to fall, you see? Because I got a good ear. When I was with Desveen we play an orchestration down…
I was going to ask about some of the brass bands, if you ever played much on, I've heard you over the last time.
